channel.title: International Consortium of Investigative Journalists ICIJ - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Consortium of Investigative Journalists ICIJ (icij.org)

item.title: Massachusetts sues Bitcoin Depot, alleging the crypto ATM operator knowingly facilitated crypto scams - ICIJ
item.description: The Massachusetts Attorney General’s lawsuit is the latest in a series of state legal actions against one of the world’s largest crypto ATM operators.

item.title: Greek court convicts Intellexa founder Tal Dilian, three others in wiretapping scandal - ICIJ
item.description: The former Israeli intelligence officer’s spyware has helped some of the world’s most brutal regimes spy on journalists and political opponents.

item.title: Advocacy group files formal grievance claiming World Bank 'failed' to address harm caused by controversial Tanzanian project - ICIJ
item.description: The project, which aimed to expand protected environmental areas and boost tourism, was terminated in 2024 after allegations of human rights abuses.

item.title: IRS criminal referrals against big corporations and ultrawealthy plummeted during Trump’s first year - ICIJ
item.description: New data shows how a key office hammered by layoffs and cost-cutting referred at most two cases in fiscal year 2025.

item.title: Lawmakers seek to stop sales to the public of ammunition made at U.S. Army plant - ICIJ
item.description: A new bill backed by Sen. Elizabeth Warren and three other Democrats came in response to an ICIJ and The New York Times investigation.

item.title: Italian authorities order expulsion of Chinese agents responsible for spying on dissidents - ICIJ
item.description: The Interior Ministry acted days after local media reported that Chinese state actors in 2024 hacked the database of a police unit assigned to protecting Chinese dissidents.

item.title: Human rights court calls on governments to crack down on weapons trafficking - ICIJ
item.description: The Inter-American Court of Human Rights said that governments have a duty to more closely monitor firearms manufacturers and put a stop to illegal trafficking.

item.title: Chelsea FC fined millions over secret payments under Abramovich ownership - ICIJ
item.description: The Premier League also handed the club a suspended transfer ban over the historical rule breaking.

item.title: Questions swirl around US plans for record $15B Prince Group crypto seizure - ICIJ
item.description: Victim advocates fear the funds seized from the Prince Group’s founder will be stashed away for the U.S.’s new strategic cryptocurrency reserve.

item.title: Canada revokes dozens of crypto firms' registrations - ICIJ
item.description: Reporting by The Toronto Star as part of ICIJ's Coin Laundry investigation found clusters of crypto services operating unlawfully.
